collectedAt.description: Timestamp of the collection pass that produced this snapshot.

value.description: For unit "usd": integer minor units (cents) — 305 means $3.05. For unit "percent": integer 0-100, percent remaining. For unit "count": a plain credit count (e.g. Google One AI credits). Values are never decimal dollars.

status.description: v1 compatibility status. New producers set verified only for a fresh validated reading; consumers needing the detailed outcome use readState.

readState.description: Detailed per-metric collection outcome. New producers always include it.

attemptedAt.description: When the extension last attempted to read this metric.

errorCode.description: Stable, safe diagnostic code; never raw provider page text.

resetWindowMs.description: Optional duration of the quota reset window. With resetAt, consumers can render remaining-time progress without provider-specific parsing.

collectedAt.description: When this specific metric was last verified. May be older than the snapshot's top-level collectedAt when only some metrics were refreshed in this pass.

display.description: Optional pre-formatted display string, e.g. "$3.05" or "88%". Not authoritative — a consumer should derive its own display from value/unit when possible; this exists for consumers that want to skip formatting.

resetText.description: Optional raw provider-page reset phrase, e.g. "Resets in 3 hr 52 min". Prefer resetAt when present.
